title: ORE Deal File
description: Root schema for an ORE (Open Real Estate) deal file. A .ore file is standard JSON conforming to this schema. v0.1 scope: US industrial, DCF and direct capitalization.

formatVersion.description: ORE format version this file conforms to (semver). This schema validates 0.1.x files.

expenses.description: Operating expense schedule, recoverable flags, management fee basis. Module schema in development — see spec/README.md for status.

marketAssumptions.description: Market rent by space type, growth curves, downtime, renewal probability, market TI/LC. Module schema in development.

valuation.description: Method, discount rate, reversion cap, hold period, selling costs. Module schema in development.

debt.description: Optional simple loan terms for levered returns. Module schema in development.

provenance.description: Who produced the file, when, source documents, broker contact. Module schema in development.
